_comment_for_adopters: Reference shape only. Replace example commands with your own scripts. Hooks should READ memory-bank context, not WRITE to it. See docs/integration-architecture.md and docs/automation-patterns.md. Claude Code has 30+ hook events today — the ones shown here are the highest-leverage for DMB. Verify event names and schema against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks before customising.

SessionStart._comment: Pre-load memory-bank essentials at session start: brief.md plus any tasks/work/*.md whose branch: matches the current git branch. Adopters supply the script.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Intent-matched memory-bank inject — when user phrasing suggests an operation, inject the relevant memory-bank slice without forcing a skill / @-mention. Useful for catching phrasings the skill descriptions don't match exactly.

PreToolUse._comment: Before any Bash command, log it. Replace with anything else you want to gate (e.g. block writes outside memory-bank/tasks/, refuse destructive git operations, etc.).

Before any write to memory-bank, route it by path. Writes to project/ or technical/ should require human review; writes to tasks/work/ and tasks/log/ are safe for automation. Adopters supply the script.

PostToolUse._comment: Optional: after edits to source code, trigger a fast lint or type-check. Keep it fast — this runs after every edit.

PreCompact._comment: Re-inject memory-bank refs before Claude compacts the context window. Without this, /compact can throw away the inventory and the user has to re-prime. Surface _index.md pointers + active tasks/work/<branch>.md so they survive compaction.

SessionEnd._comment: Opt-in: write a short session summary back to tasks/work/<branch>.md or to a daily journal file. Aligns with DMB's RAM-layer pattern (one file per topic). Keep it tight — append, don't rewrite. Disable for headless / CI runs.

permissions._comment_for_adopters: Allowlist commands you trust to run without prompting. Keep this minimal at first; add entries as you confirm them. The harness prompts for anything not listed here.
